statement: Settlement finality is profile-relative and domain-relative.
Consensus does not imply settlement finality.
Authority completeness does not imply settlement finality.
Distributed admissibility does not imply settlement finality.
Execution does not imply settlement finality.
Atomic completion does not imply settlement finality.
Settlement finality does not imply irreversibility.
Settlement finality does not imply continuity preservation.
Local finality does not imply finality in another domain.
Local finality does not imply cross-domain finality.
Technical finality and legal finality are not equivalent.
Ledger inclusion does not imply settlement finality.
Indeterminate finality cannot be promoted to FINAL.
Later reversal does not erase historical finality status.
Cross-domain finality requires every required domain and cross-domain consistency condition.
